subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

Ravi said, "I may join the conference next week."

options.text: Ravi said that he might join the conference the following week.
Ravi said he may join the conference next week.
Ravi said he would join the conference next week.
Ravi told that he might attend the conference.

solution: ```html The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Ravi said that he might join the conference the following week. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"may"** is used to express possibility, permission, or likelihood in the present or future. (संभव है, अनुमति देना) • **Example:** I may go to the park if it stops raining. • **"Might"** is the past tense of "may," and it is often used in indirect speech to indicate a possibility or likelihood that was discussed in the past. (संभव था) • **Example:** She said she might visit her grandmother this weekend. • In indirect speech, "may" changes to "might" to reflect the past tense of the reporting verb "said." Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2:** Ravi said he may join the conference next week. (रवि ने कहा कि वह अगले सप्ताह सम्मेलन में शामिल हो सकता है।) • This sentence incorrectly keeps "may" in indirect speech, which should change to "might" as per the rules of indirect speech. • **Option 3:** Ravi said he would join the conference next week. (रवि ने कहा कि वह अगले सप्ताह सम्मेलन में शामिल होगा।) • This sentence incorrectly uses "would," which implies certainty rather than possibility. • **Option 4:** Ravi told that he might attend the conference. (रवि ने बताया कि वह सम्मेलन में शामिल हो सकता है।) • This sentence incorrectly uses "told" instead of "said." "Told" requires an object, e.g., "Ravi told me." Question: Ravi said, "I may join the conference next week." The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Ravi said that he might join the conference the following week. ``` 3d:Tc63, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "She said, 'I am feeling better after rest.'"
